excluded_under_broadened_rubric_note: Rescreened all Brazil/LATAM-tagged listings across quality, regulatory affairs, and medical affairs (not just clinical ops/trial management) per the broadened rubric. Only additional candidates found were ClinChoice's Brazil-based Safety Officer, Drug Safety Associate, Medical Reviewer, and Regulatory Affairs Analyst roles — all titled 'Consultant' (contract) and/or junior-level, which score below 60 because they don't offer equal-or-better long-term pay/career growth vs. the candidate's current Portfolio Manager role. Also searched Brazilian-market employers directly on Gupy (Synvia, IDOR, Eurofarma, Rennova): excluded lab-technician/nursing/finance/QC/pre-clinical-R&D postings as out of scope, and excluded mid-level ('Pleno') and junior/broad-band postings (CRA all-levels, Monitor Sênior individual-contributor site-monitoring, Analista de Assuntos Regulatórios, Analista de Farmacovigilância Sr, Analista de Desenvolvimento Clínico Pleno) that score below 60 once compensation and seniority step-down from a portfolio-management role are weighed honestly. Rede D'Or's main 1,607-job board, Hospital Santa Lucinda, PUCRS, and Cristália/Hypera Pharma were checked and ruled out (wrong function or no current openings) in favor of IDOR (Rede D'Or's dedicated research institute). Checked three additional Brazilian-native job platforms (Catho, InfoJobs, Vagas.com) for a usable public API or structured feed like Gupy's: none exists -- all three are pure server-rendered HTML with no embedded JSON (no __NEXT_DATA__, no JobPosting JSON-LD, no genuine RSS/XML feed -- the .rss/.xml URL suffixes on Vagas.com just fall through to the same HTML page), so none were added as a provider; scraping raw HTML would be materially more fragile than every other provider in this pipeline and was deliberately not built. Added a 7th provider, Workday, after confirming a public unauthenticated JSON search API (wday/cxs/{tenant}/{site}/jobs) for IQVIA, Parexel, Syneos Health, ICON plc, and Fortrea -- the major CROs previously missing entirely. Medpace (uses iCIMS, uscareers-medpace.icims.com) and PPD/Thermo Fisher clinical research (uses Phenom People, jobs.thermofisher.com) were confirmed NOT on Workday and are not covered by any provider in this pipeline. From ~303 Workday postings matched by searchText 'Brazil'/'LATAM' across the five companies, excluded the large majority as generic CRA/coordinator/associate-level individual-contributor roles (consistent with how plain CRA/Analista-level roles are scored elsewhere), out-of-function roles (software engineering, sales/commercial, legal, HR, logistics, translators), and a few Manager/Director-level roles that on closer inspection (job-detail location check) turned out to be Mexico-only remote, not actually Brazil-eligible (Syneos Health's Mgr/Sr Regulatory CMC Consultant, ICON's Medical Director (Endocrinology)) -- both excluded under the hard Brazil-workability requirement despite matching the LATAM text search. Added a Director/Country Manager 'stretch/leadership' search (tagged `tier: Stretch/Leadership` when found): confirmed working Gupy boards for Aché (vagasache.gupy.io) and Hypera Pharma (hyperapharma.gupy.io) and added both to fetch_gupy_jobs.py's COMPANIES (previously Hypera was checked once and deprioritized for lacking clinical-ops-relevant postings -- now tracked for leadership-level ones too); could not confirm a working Gupy subdomain for EMS Farmacêutica despite several guesses and secondary sources naming ems.gupy.io (genuine 404, not DNS failure -- possibly deactivated/migrated). Full title lists (not just keyword-filtered) for Aché, Hypera Pharma, and Eurofarma's Gupy boards were scanned for Director/Country Manager/VP-level titles: zero found. Checked LinkedIn and Indeed manually (both explicitly disallow job-search scraping in robots.txt, so no automated provider was built for either): one plausible-looking result (a 'Director, Clinical Operations' posting at Sun Pharma) turned out to be expired (404) when opened directly, confirming these platforms' search results can't be trusted as live without individual verification -- no LinkedIn/Indeed-sourced entries were added this round since nothing verifiably live and Brazil-relevant was found. Recalibrated the whole dataset to a stricter level model this round: added a Manager-level floor (excluding individual-contributor/analyst/associate/specialist/consultant-titled roles even when the function was a strong fit -- e.g. Senior Regulatory and Start Up Specialist, Lead Clinical Research Associate, Senior Clinical QA Specialist, MSL, TMF Lead II, and all Analista/Especialista-titled Gupy roles -- 20 entries removed in total), and split the survivors into level: "Primary" (Senior Manager/Associate Director/Regional Director-equivalent scope, matching the candidate's actual 5.5 years of experience) versus level: "Reach" (Director/VP/Country-Manager-equivalent scope, tagged "Reach — Long Shot" and sorted separately in the report) -- only ICON's Medical Director qualified as Reach among existing matches. Applied a modest score bump plus a reason note to genuinely LATAM/EMEA-spanning roles (e.g. Syneos Regulatory CMC Manager CGT spans LATAM and Serbia) where the candidate's trilingual capacity (EN C2/PT C2/DE B1) is a specific, named differentiator, not just generic language skill. Broadened the search beyond pharma/CRO entirely for capacity-based matches (large multi-country programs, executive/named-client relationships, bid/proposal leadership, 50+ person team oversight) in any industry: confirmed Accenture and Kyndryl on Workday with real Sao Paulo/Rio-based Director/Associate-Director/bid-leadership roles (5 added, one -- Kyndryl's Director, Customer Unit Leader -- tagged Reach); checked and found no usable public ATS API for Globant, EPAM Systems, Endava, Capgemini, DXC Technology, NTT Data, Cognizant, Wipro, Infosys, TCS, IBM, AECOM, Jacobs Engineering, WSP Global, Fluor, and Bechtel (most run custom/proprietary career portals); TELUS Digital Brazil has a Greenhouse board (telusdigitalbr) with no live postings, and Thoughtworks is on Greenhouse with 46 jobs but none Brazil-eligible/senior enough as of this check. Aug 16 2026 check: re-ran the full fetch across all seven providers (1347 raw postings) and diffed against already-tracked matches to find 6 genuinely new entries: Precision Medicine Group's Account Development Manager and Manager, Global Investigator Grants (LATAM) (the latter also now posted under the Precision for Medicine sibling, so it enriches an existing dedup-merged entry rather than surfacing as a second new match); Kyndryl's Project Manager (Hortolandia, Sao Paulo); IQVIA's Coordenador de Operacoes de Negocios (Sao Paulo, genuine ops-leadership scope despite "Coordenador" title); and two Brazilian-market Gupy postings -- Eurofarma's Coordenador(a) Planejamento Estrategico and Hypera's Coordenador(a) de Planejamento - Mercado Institucional, both judged genuine site/functional-leadership scope under the local-title-convention exception. Excluded this round: Iovance Biotherapeutics' new bare "Remote" Associate Director/Director/Executive Director postings -- no explicit Brazil restriction in the text, but a US-specific pay-transparency widget plus the established finding that Iovance has never had a genuine Brazil/LATAM-remote posting made this a judgment call to exclude rather than assume the situation changed without stronger positive evidence; Care Access's "USA Remote" roles (not Brazil-eligible); PSI CRO's US/Canada/UK-remote roles (not Brazil-eligible) and its Sao Paulo-based Data Manager/Lead Data Manager roles (individual-contributor/technical, below the Manager-level floor); EDETEK's Clinical Data Manager and Senior Pricing/Proposal Specialist (IC/Specialist-level); ICON's Medical Director (Endocrinology), re-confirmed Mexico-only and not Brazil-eligible, consistent with the prior finding; Kyndryl's Jr Project Manager (explicitly Junior); Precision Medicine Group's Proposal Associate and Clinical Data Manager (Associate/IC-level); Hypera's Gerente de Marketplace B2B (temporary contract, wrong function) and Gerente de Produtos Junior (explicitly Junior despite the Gerente title); Ache's Coordenador de Designers (wrong function -- design/creative, not clinical-ops/capacity-relevant despite the Coordenador title); and Eurofarma's Gerente de Produtos Sr (both variants) and Gerente Novos Negocios Pl (product-marketing function doesn't clearly fit either scoring lane / "Pl"=Pleno mid-level despite the Gerente title). Re-ran the Director/Country-Manager-level stretch search (Gupy Ache/EMS/Hypera/Eurofarma plus manual LinkedIn/Indeed check): found nothing verifiably live and genuinely Director-level/Brazil-relevant this round (Eurofarma's only "Diret*" matches were Comprador Pl/Sr - Diretos, i.e. "direct" purchasing, not Diretor) -- consistent with the established pattern that director-level roles are typically filled through executive search rather than public postings.
